name: Контроль публікацій та автоматичних проходів

findings.finding: Importer has42 repeated errors:34 immutable-digest collisions and8 nonproduction QA identities discovered as production reports. Four current source digests differ, two semantically. Styria says0published remotely vs1 locally; the actual approved event and first-publication index both exist. Upper Austria candidates4 vs26, rejected1 vs23. Latest19 runIDs match local, so this is not19 missing source folders.
findings.recommendedChange: Use immutable report revisions and an explicit latest pointer; classify/skip QA artifacts, preserve old evidence and reconcile semantic revisions rather than blindly overwriting history.

findings.finding: Importer writes syncedAt on every attempt, including errors42/imported0. UI calls this reportsUpdated and uses it for the2h stale threshold. A fresh heartbeat does not establish fresh synchronized report data.
findings.recommendedChange: Separate lastAttemptAt, successful-import/check timestamps and per-source completion times; expose concrete affected reports.

findings.finding: Both page3 failures preserve rows1/2 initially, but the actual Retry action requests cursor=nil and replaces them with page1. Calls observed:first,second,third,first. Two desired-behavior probe tests failed.
findings.recommendedChange: Store the failed operation/cursor and retry exactly it, preserving loaded pages and region/day context.

findings.finding: Every overview/items request reads all daily index documents, sorts/filters in memory, then slices30. Permanent report collisions are retried roughly each minute; last pass contains34collisions and8unsupported identities. Writer reads both run and source before detecting a digest mismatch.
findings.recommendedChange: Real indexed server pagination and compact counts; bounded session reads; quarantine/version permanent conflicts and retry transient failures with explicit status.

findings.finding: History request ignores selected region and reads global pages80; UI filters them afterward. Selecting unknown region leaves a blank area because empty state checks global runs.isEmpty.
findings.recommendedChange: Send region to the backend, paginate within that filter, and show a meaningful filtered-empty state.

findings.finding: Maximum Dynamic Type in Ukrainian pushes the compact date/summary beyond the viewport. In German, fixed two-column labels break into near-letter columns and consume multiple screens. MediumAX passing did not cover maximum-size readability.
findings.recommendedChange: Responsive date presentation and single-column/reflowing metric layout at accessibility sizes, preserving full text.

findings.finding: Report details remain mostly raw English strings. Publication-date counts and latest source checks share the same top date/region area. Errors need a source, consequence and next action. The Retry under import errors only rereads the callable; it cannot repair the local observer.
findings.recommendedChange: Retain four useful tabs with a compact context-aware summary; clear latest-vs-selected-day labels, accessible details and accurate action names.

findings.finding: Rows format absolute dates in device timezone while publication-day key/picker use Vienna. Staleness is fixed3h for news although active regional news schedules are09/14/19, five-hour gaps and overnight pauses.
findings.recommendedChange: One explicit Vienna clock contract and schedule-aware overdue diagnostics; controlled DST/date-boundary cases.

findings.finding: Old contentDraftReady notifications still open the separate planning/editor workflow. Its viewmodel uses UID equality without a session generation; fetchDraftForDeepLink and mutation continuations lack complete post-await scope checks.12 current tests pass but do not prove role-revocation/A->B->A safety.
findings.recommendedChange: Keep compatibility explicitly scoped and add generation/permission/cancellation fences and controlled late-response scenarios before changing old drafts.

findings.finding: Dormant testOwnerContentPlanningExposesFourStableSections still expects the old planning screen from the profile entry, which now opens PublicationControl. This is a stale test expectation, separate from product defects.
findings.recommendedChange: Test the control entry and legacy draft-notification entry as distinct routes; do not disable business assertions.

validation.check: Existing publication Swift unit +normal/mediumAX UI tests
Explicit maxAX/warning, six nonowner profiles, filtered history observations
validation.note: Capture/navigation success is not visual acceptance; clipping and empty-state defects were observed.
Temporary probes archived under build; failing acceptance tests are not added to normal CI.

validation.check: Actual server handlers/index behavior in isolated demo emulator

validation.note: TS+compiledJS, auth and permissions checked; no new deployment or induced Eventarc delivery.

productionReadback.boundary: Partial source checks are real independent coverage gaps. Correcting importer/UI does not establish full source coverage.

performanceBoundary: Source evidence proves repeated full-day scans and permanent error retries; no physical iPhone callable latency or Time Profiler trace was measured. Mac REST reads0.28–0.52s are not device launch timings. Cloud Run request query returned no samples.
implementationPackages: Report revision/discovery/freshness bridge with immutable history and readback
Cursor/filter/context-safe screen data layer plus legacy session fences
Responsive summary, four coherent tabs and actionable localized diagnostics
Repeat failing and linked flows, exact deployed-source verification after any approved deployment, then separate signed-device and TestFlight gates
remainingAcceptance: Fix and repeat the exact failing page3->retry scenarios
Signed physical owner-account read and date/filter/detail/return paths
Long-running late response and A->B->A in legacy draft compatibility modals
Explicit event child fixture/runtime, picker date/DST/travel timezone cases
Full corrected narrow/maxAX layout after implementation
